Bill.BriefDescription: Exempting from prevailing wage requirements public works projects undertaken to repair fire damage.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to exempting from prevailing wage requirementspublic works projects undertaken to repair fire damage; adding a newsection to chapter 39.12 RCW; and providing an expiration date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 39.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) This chapter does not apply to a public works project that isundertaken to repair damage caused by a wildfire that: (a) Exceedstwenty thousand acres in size; and (b) originates in a county east ofthe summit of the Cascade mountains. (2) For purposes of this section, "wildfire" means a fire thatresults in a mobilization by the department of natural resources. (3) This section expires July 1, 2015.
